name: Challenge - Mindhunter
description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something huge and inhuman has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can try to fight it, but it just keeps coming -- no matter how far or fast you run, it always finds you again.  The only way this ends is if one of you dies.

name: Challenge - Heart of Fire
description: You always loved setting fires as a child, sometimes spending hours just watching the flames.  That fire awakened in you during the Cataclysm, powerful and almost uncontrollable.  You can call up flames from thin air, burn zombies to ash with a thought, surround yourself in a blazing inferno, but the fire demands release.  It's like an internal pressure, growing as long as you don't use your powers, until it flows out as the flames rise.  Can you survive in the new world without burning yourself to ash?
